name: APIVerveFullyQualifiedDomain
summary: Fully Qualified Domain resolves an IP address to its fully qualified domain name using reverse DNS PTR records.
description:
Fully Qualified Domain resolves an IP address to its fully qualified domain name using reverse DNS PTR records. It returns the host FQDN, base domain, TLD, subdomain, and domain level count.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Fully Qualified Domain from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
